prompt:
Subject: John Calvin teaching Reformed Christian doctrine.

Composition: John Calvin, with a long pointed beard, black scholar cap, and dark robe, teaches two listeners from an open Bible at a plain wooden lectern. The pages contain only tiny unreadable scripture strokes; no doctrinal sentence.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, explanatory labels, speech balloons or bubbles, numerals, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: John Calvin teaches Calvinism from an open Bible to two listeners.
ja: ジョン・カルビンが二人の聴衆に、開いた聖書からカルビン主義を教えています。
